profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point in Somerset County, New Jersey, tagged telecom=data_center, is named Vital Records. As with a similarly named Iron Mountain records-storage site documented earlier in this project's research, a "vital records" or general records-storage business stores physical documents, microfilm, or backup media in a climate-controlled warehouse setting, a genuinely different function from a colocation or cloud data center that houses active server infrastructure, network cross-connects, and computing capacity for outside IT customers. The overlap in public perception between "records storage" and "data center" likely explains why this site picked up a telecom=data_center tag despite functioning as a document- and media-storage warehouse rather than a compute facility. Confirming the specific company operating under the Vital Records name at this New Jersey location, and its exact service offering, was not possible this session due to search-tool quota limits, but the site is filed here as a probable physical-records storage facility rather than a compute-oriented data center, consistent with the project's established honest-exception treatment of this category.
